title: Get in touch
slide_intent: Close the book with a clear route for follow-up. A reader who needs clarification should be able to find the contact details immediately.
strategic_value: The final page can keep the guidelines attributable to Frontline AIDS and connect a reader with the communications contacts listed in this edition.
demonstration: A pink field carries a contact block at upper left, a large black logo at upper right and a compact campaign line at lower right.
practical_value: Place the contact route where a reader returning to the back page can find it. Treat the listed names and addresses as details from the January 2021 guide.

content_islands.name: Contact block
content_islands.spec: Stack the heading, two named contacts with email addresses and the bold website address at upper left.

content_islands.name: Closing identity
content_islands.spec: Set the black brand lockup at upper right and the short strapline at lower right. Leave the central pink field open.
